title: Skyline
description: A detailed product case study focused on clarity, hierarchy, and calm motion.

details.overview: Skyline walks through layout systems, interaction polish, and the decisions that keep a dense interface readable across desktop and mobile.
details.challenge: Dense product UIs tend to compete for attention, making scanning and decision-making slower for users.
details.solution: A structured layout system with restrained motion and clear visual hierarchy keeps complex content approachable without sacrificing depth.
